title: MustChill
description: Optimizations, smooth-animations and enhanced visual over vanilla.
body:
# MustChill
### About
A client-side modpack that enhance vanilla visuals, sounds and performance. New generation from mod [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) enhance boring vanilla generation with new vanilla biomes and structures. With beast distance mod render [voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) you can see all the biomes and terrain from afar. 
Modpack already have social mods like [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) and [EmoteCraft](https://modrinth.com/plugin/emotecraft). 
### You can see the optimization and visuals in the gallery.
a graphic card with 4.6 OpenGl support is required

**Recommended GPU**
- NVIDIA GTX 900┃1050 or higher
- AMD Radeon RX 400 or higher
- Intel HD Graphics 500┃Iris Plus,Xe or higher
